about: The 3 v1 weapons. Each is a copy of a vanilla Fallout: New Vegas weapon record, made on the player's PC by the launcher from their own FalloutNV.esm into Data/CSNV.esp before every Play (nothing from Bethesda is shipped; models, sounds and animations stay the game's own, nothing from CS2 is used). Multipliers apply to the base record's own values. Base form IDs are FalloutNV.esm IDs taken from public lists; the launcher refuses to write a weapon whose base form is missing or not a WEAP and logs it, and the in-game script prints a CSNV error line if a plugin form does not resolve.

columns.id: unique weapon id (also the aux-variable key the clone is stored under)
columns.name: in-game name (original, CS-flavoured, not a Valve trademark)
columns.base_form: FalloutNV.esm form ID of the vanilla weapon that is cloned
columns.base_name: the vanilla weapon's in-game name (for humans checking base_form)
columns.plugin_form: form ID of the copy inside CSNV.esp (local index; the launcher writes it as 01xxxxxx)
columns.ammo_form: FalloutNV.esm form ID of the ammo given with the purchase
columns.damage_mult: multiplier on the base DATA 'Base Damage' (rounded)
columns.fire_rate_mult: multiplier on the base DNAM 'Fire Rate' and 'Attack Shots/Sec'
columns.verified: true once bought and fired in the running game
